[yellow bold]-- RETRY SIDE EFFECT -- main.volt:6[/yellow bold]

mutation to `counter` inside retry'd `try` block; side effects will repeat on each retry.

 [dim]5 |[/dim]     try {
 [dim]6 |[/dim]         counter += 1
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]        ^^^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: Move the mutation outside the try, or verify the operation is idempotent.[/cyan]
